/* Modifeid and verified for Y2k....Sobha...06/99 */
declare
 t_date date;
 rpt_chk varchar2(200);
begin
 if :system.record_status not in ('INSERT','CHANGED') then
 return;
 end if;
--
------------------- parameter must be entered ---------------------
--
 if :parm_select.parm_select is null then
 if :system.cursor_record > 1 then
 clear_record;
 return;
 else
 if :ctrl_block.check_parm = 'Y' then
 message ('Err: Parameter value must be entered ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
--
------------- change to upper case, if upper case flag = Y -------------
--
 if :parm_def.upper_case_flag = 'Y' then
 :parm_select.parm_select := upper(:parm_select.parm_select);
 end if;
--
------------------- skip validation, if paramter = ALL -----------------
--
 if :parm_select.parm_select = 'ALL' then
 return;
 end if;
--
------------------- validate wrt field type ------------------------
--
 if :parm_def.code_type = 'NUMBER' then
 begin
 if check_numeric (:system.cursor_value) = FALSE then
 message ('Err: Parameter value should be numeric ');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'DATE' then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 6 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,5,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 8 then
 if instr(:system.cursor_value,'-') > 0 then
 null;
 elsif instr(:system.cursor_value,'-') <= 0 then
 raise value_error;
 end if; 
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 t_date := to_date(:system.cursor_value,'MM-DD-RR');
 exception
 when others then
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be MM-DD-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'DATETM' then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 10 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,5,2) || ' ' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,7,2) || ':' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,9,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 14 then
 null;
 else
 raise value_error;
 end if;
 t_date := to_date(:system.cursor_value,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 exception
 when others then
 message('Err: Invalid datetime format. Must be MM-DD-YY HH:MI');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'ODATE' then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 7 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,2) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,3,3) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,6,2);
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 9 then
 null;
 else
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be DD-MON-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 t_date := to_date(:system.cursor_value,'DD-MON-RR');
 exception
 when others then
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be DD-MON-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'MONYY' then
 begin
 if NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 5 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 substr(:system.cursor_value,1,3) || '-' ||
 substr(:system.cursor_value,4,2) ;
 elsif NVL(length(:system.cursor_value), 0) = 6 then
 null;
 else
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be MON-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 t_date := to_date(:system.cursor_value,'MON-RR');
 exception
 when others then
 message ('Err: Invalid date format. Must be MON-YY');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 end if;
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 :parm_select.ref_table := :parm_def.ref_table;
 :parm_select.ref_column := :parm_def.ref_column;
 if :parm_select.ref_table is not null and
 :parm_select.ref_column is not null then
 begin
 select decode(instr(:system.cursor_value,'%'),0,'N','Y')
 into :parm_select.wildcard_ind from dual;
 end;
--
 /* user_exit ('rptcheck');
 if form_failure
 then
 if :parm_select.err_msg is null
 then
 :parm_select.err_msg :=
 'Err: Checking paramater wrt ref table';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 message ( :parm_select.err_msg);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 */
 :system.message_level := '25';
 rpt_chk := don_common_pack.rpt_validate(:parm_select.ref_table,:parm_select.ref_column,
 :parm_select.parm_select,:parm_select.wildcard_ind);
-- message('value of rpchk '||rpt_chk);
-- pause;
 :system.message_level := '10';
 if rpt_chk = 'SUCCESS' then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err: value not validated');
 --RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('2319');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

declare

if :parm_def.ref_table IS NULL then

procedure get_parm_select is
/*
 If report parameter values already exist, then they are brought in
 by execute_query. Otherwise, the defaults are brought by a cursor
 fetch.
 If the report has no parameters, then the parameter entry block is
 skipped & user can enter submit parameters.
*/
begin
 :system.message_level := '10';
 :system.suppress_working := 'TRUE';
 if :parm_def.parm_select is null then
 set_item_property('parm_select.parm_select', required, property_false);

 execute_query;
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW' -- no records found
 then
 :parm_select.report_name := :parm_def.report_name;
 :parm_select.user_name := :ref_block.user_name ;
 :parm_select.parm_id := :ctrl_block.parm_id ;

 :parm_select.list_form_name := :parm_def.list_form_name;
--
 if :parm_def.code_type = 'DATETM'
 then
 if substr(:parm_def.default_value,1,7) = 'SYSDATE'
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 if NVL(length(:parm_def.default_value), 0) > 7
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char(trunc(sysdate +
 to_number(substr(:parm_def.default_value,8,15)))
 ,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 end if;
 end if;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type = 'DATE'
 then
 if substr(:parm_def.default_value,1,7) = 'SYSDATE'
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char(trunc(sysdate),'MM-DD-RR');
 if NVL(length(:parm_def.default_value), 0) > 7
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char( to_date
 (:parm_select.parm_select,'MM-DD-RR') +
 to_number(substr(:parm_def.default_value,8,15))
 ,'MM-DD-RR') ;
 end if;
 end if;
 elsif :parm_def.code_type in ('ODATE')
 then
 if substr(:parm_def.default_value,1,7) = 'SYSDATE'
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char(trunc(sysdate),'DD-MON-RR');
 if NVL(length(:parm_def.default_value), 0) > 7
 then
 :parm_select.parm_select :=
 to_char( to_date
 (:parm_select.parm_select,'DD-MON-RR') +
 to_number(substr(:parm_def.default_value,8,15))
 ,'DD-MON-RR') ;
 end if;
 end if;
 else
 :parm_select.parm_select := :parm_def.default_value;
 end if;
 --
 first_record;
 end if;
 --

end;
